title: FC Barcelona's US Tour: The Movie 2017
original_title: FC Barcelona's US Tour: The Movie 2017
overview: Follow FC Barcelona on their 2017 preseason tour of the United States as the team travels across New York, Washington, D.C., and Miami. Featuring behind-the-scenes access, training sessions, matches against Juventus, Manchester United, and Real Madrid, and unforgettable moments with fans, the documentary captures the club's preparations for a new season.
